known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: Only Group name/disabled/create/delete metadata certified. No IAM/S3 policy evaluation, ACL enforcement, storage/object bytes, multipart upload, service credential/key generation or network effects invoked.

Carrier is original ServiceAccount.content JSON with its preexisting free-text description key, returned by original serviceaccount_get. This exact existing source shape is used; no body schema invented.

Original s3:Admin action and source member/policy-empty deletion guards retained; lower privilege, duplicate and nonempty-group rejection actually probed. Username business key maps session.account_name, and user/group member references renamed consistently.
Opaque ServiceAccount id normalized to integer for source lookup; serviceaccount_create metadata mapping remains unclaimed, no genuine service-account provisioning claim.
